review.purpose: Fixed-candidate admission diagnostic; no semantic gold, relationship label, universal-coverage claim, Bootstrap change or hierarchy generation.
review.planned_inputs: Two separately receipt-bound meaning-only inputs and two original A/B assignments in each member order, repeated once:12 fresh requests total. Candidate facts and diagnostic prompt/schema remain identical.
review.assessment: Compare candidate admission by the named definition across draws, A/B assignment and member order. Missing/duplicate node-candidate records are invalid diagnostics, not semantic shifts.
review.qualification: Single inputs omit the separate subject field; pair inputs contain subject plus meaning. Differences measure presentation/context sensitivity, not isolated counterpart causality. Two draws do not establish reliability.
